Fresh routine Sol/Ultra repair author, one task. Work only in
`/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-574-merge-title-lean-code-lines`,
branch `issue-574-merge-title-lean-code-lines`, expected clean head
`723e2d2ac6783b2cfe2fea78cacd2fc6b0088874`. MAIN owns this repair after the
independent reviewer Galileo retired. No other helper writer holds577.
Use PRIMARY `/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin/` for workflow tools.

Read the owner issue574, current four-file PR577 patch, applicable trusted
main instructions and `/tmp/pr577-independent-review-20260917-sol.md`.
Only unresolved findingF1 is in scope: the scanner resets string state at
physical newlines, so a VALID ordinary multiline Lean string containing `/-`
opens a false comment and hides later real declarations from the delta.

Keep ordinary double-quoted string and necessary escape state through physical
newlines until the actual closing quote. Preserve existing nested comment,
same-line string, trailing-comment and blank-line behavior. Add a focused
regression in existing MergeSubjectTests that edits a later theorem after
the review's multiline literal and checks the real delta counts that edit;
include a small mask check only if it verifies a separate useful boundary.
The review already verified the literal with Lean; reuse its evidence unless
your changed example needs a specific new parse check.

Keep this a small lexer repair, not a complete Lean parser, new framework,
merge gate, transport/ref change or fallback redesign. Existing API and
cosmetic failure contract remain. Update any directly contradictory comments,
docstrings/protocol prose in this PR, and draft a truthful amended PR body
under `/tmp/pr577-f1-repair-20260917-pr-body.md`; preserve the predecessor body
and owner issue linkage. No unrelated cleanup or new review findings.

Use apply_patch, focused relevant Python tests, git diff --check, installed
hook check and an ordinary additive `fix(review): ...` commit. Never amend or
rewrite published history. Keep the worktree clean at handback. Full CI,
publication, review/status and daemon merge remain MAIN's later steps; do not
run them. Do not merge/rebase main during this task. The main tree may move
through a daemon merge of386; preserve this bounded repair for later refresh.

Return exact commit, changed paths, checks/limits, PR-body draft and a receipt
under `/tmp/pr577-f1-repair-20260917-*`, with artifact hashes. This author cannot
review577 later; MAIN will request a fresh independent Opus review after gates.

No primary/other-worktree edits, cache reset/write, key/config/daemon change,
actual merge gate, GH edits, push, CI/full build/render, codex exec,
dispatch.sh/review.sh/autofix/lane/Opus runner/chsh/descendant/other key.
Budget420 seconds including final60 for commit/receipt; absolute deadline at
admission. One task then retire; MAIN plus you is relay-1 capacity.
